integrity: Proof uses Gaussian conditioning, integration by parts, and finite inclusion-exclusion; numerical replication is a diagnostic only. No independent validation or publication certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite number of strains; iid standard Gaussian co-colonization interactions; only strict monomorphic ESSs are counted. Asymptotic error constants depend on the number of strains. No claims for mixed equilibria, biological outcomes, non-Gaussian interactions or historical uniqueness.
title: A sharp inverse-co-colonization law for multiple monomorphic evolutionary stable states
